title: Test Plan Acceptance Contract
description: Criteria for operating test plans that guide delivery teams

dimensions.name: Scope clarity
dimensions.criterion: Plan explains what is in scope, out of scope, and why

levels.definition: Scope section explicitly lists covered features and excluded areas with rationale
Scope is implicit or vague; unclear what will/won't be tested

dimensions.name: Signal-oriented exit criteria
dimensions.criterion: Exit criteria are defined by signal quality, not arbitrary dates

levels.definition: Plan defines signal thresholds (coverage %, pass rates, flake tolerance) for go/no-go
Exit criteria undefined or based only on calendar date

dimensions.name: Risk acknowledgment
dimensions.criterion: Plan acknowledges known risks and mitigation strategies

levels.definition: Identifies high-risk areas (hotspots, new code) and how they're tested
Some risks mentioned but mitigation unclear
No risk acknowledgment; plan treats all areas as equal priority

passing_criteria: scope_clarity=PASS AND signal_oriented=PASS AND weighted avg >= 0.85
